en: This is a vintage illustrated postcard featuring three scenes from Bad Pyrmont, Germany. The illustrations include a pavilion at Brunnenplatz with a church in the background, a view down Schlossstrasse (a street with notable buildings), and a view of Schloss (castle) by a waterway with rowboats. The card is addressed to someone in Minden and stamped 'Deutsches Reich' with a 5-pfennig green stamp. Handwritten German text is present on both sides. The upper left of the correspondence side reads 'GRUSS aus Bad Pyrmont', suggesting it's a greeting from the spa town.
